promptHead: Athlete goal: 5K (Corrowmore Harvest 5K) on Sun Nov 15 2026, 3 weeks out, target run the whole way.

answers.question: I haven't run for two weeks. Do I have to start again from the beginning? And is the 5K in four weeks still realistic?
answers.answer: You can restart from the beginning – the body will adapt quickly once you get back to regular running.  The 5‑K in three weeks is realistic if you stay on the plan and manage stress and recovery well.

new.analysis:
This week is the first run after a two‑week break, so we keep the total volume light but introduce a single quality effort to start building race‑pace confidence.  The new‑runner profile and the fact that the athlete is in the peak phase with only three runs per week means a 5 km easy on Monday, a 3 km quality on Wednesday, and a longer 6 km easy on Saturday gives a sensible progression without overreaching.  Rest days on Tue, Thu, Fri and Sun are kept long to allow full recovery; sleep and stress are high so monitoring these will keep the training plan safe.
